_note: Numbers invented for the damage, time, crit, streak and enemy-skip rules (owner B, missions 2-5). Check them. min_enemy_damage: an enemy hit never does less than this. rounding: round = half goes up, floor = always down, ceil = always up. time_limit_seconds: seconds per question by difficulty. typed_extra_seconds: extra seconds for a typed answer. min_time_limit_seconds: a heavy weapon takes seconds away, but a question never gets less time than this. crit_difficulties: only questions of these difficulties can be a crit (26 Nov 2026: easy questions no longer crit, so the quick multiple-choice basics do not double the damage). crit_tiers: an answer that uses at most this share of its time limit is a crit; checked from the fastest. The share is measured on the normal time limit, without the seconds that items add (26 Nov 2026: made tighter after the play-test, was 0.15 and 0.30). streak: bonus_per_right for each right answer in a row, up to max_multiplier. enemy_skip_chance: chance the enemy skips its turn after a miss. habits: the spammer rule in ai/habits.py; using the same move spam_turns turns in a row makes the enemy's damage x spam_damage, once per enemy. Tier damage and bonus_damage are in moves.json; enemy damage is in enemies.json.
